Banned for Kill Aura, Anti-Knockback

I was playing Nebula and there was some lag so it looked like I wasn't dying but in reality I was killed immediately as I was swarmed and the next thing you know I'm banned. Listen, I love Avicus but if moderators can't differentiate between lag and hacks, there's something wrong with the way this server punishes players, and it would hurt me to leave but what can y'do? 

Thanks for reviewing,
sbokhary00
